character: A broad, sunburned man in his late thirties. A beard dyed bright red. Gold rings on every finger. A big open-mouthed shout, chin up, chest out.
wardrobe: A fine blue captain's coat slightly too large for him, a red sash wound twice round his waist, a rapier at his hip.

full.framing: Full body portrait, front view. Standing on a quarterdeck, one boot on the rail, rapier raised.

portrait.framing: Head and shoulders portrait, square crop, filling the frame, facing the viewer.

scene.framing: Shouting from the quarterdeck of a two-masted ship under a plain red flag as his crew throw grapnels across to another ship.
